embeds.title: Weekly dev summary: owner/repo
embeds.description:
## Weekly Development Summary

This week focused on reliability and release readiness. Contributors merged three pull requests, closed two user-facing bugs, and continued incremental dependency cleanup.

### Highlights
- Improved API error handling around failed upstream requests.
- Closed stale onboarding issues after documentation updates.
- Merged a focused test coverage improvement for billing edge cases.

### Risks
The release branch still has one large dependency update that should receive manual review before deployment.
